summary.text: Kamigawa is a plane strongly based on Japanese culture, with two symbiotic worlds, the material utsushiyo and the kami spirit realm kakuriyo, home to humans, kami, kitsune, nezumi, ogres, orochi and akki.

bio.text: The Kami War began when Lord Konda raided the Spirit World and tore out O-Kagachi's heart, and the enraged kami attacked the mortal world to reclaim what was taken.
In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda freed the scion Kyodai and defeated O-Kagachi and her father Konda, and O-Kagachi's death merged the two realms.
Michiko and Kyodai then took over O-Kagachi's role as guardians of the veil, and the Sisters formed from their union.

Over a thousand years later the Saiba Futurists and akki enhancers sparked a technology boom, and the Order of Jukai, the Imperials and Minamo built merge gates around rifts that ejected confused kami.
Tezzeret came to Kamigawa and used a prototype Reality Chip on Kyodai, which destabilized the Emperor's spark, and Jin-Gitaxias then arrived and compleated Tamiyo.
The Phyrexians then invaded, compleating samurai and slaughtering the incompleatable kami, until the Wanderer returned and killed the compleated Tamiyo.
After the Desparkening the Wanderer lost her spark and traveled the plane while Light-Paws ruled as regent, and years later Ikoria's monsters invaded Kamigawa through a massive Omenpath.
In the Echoverse of Reality Fracture, Tamiyo seized the throne and Yuriko pledged her loyalty.

status.text: In the latest story, from the Reality Fracture material, Tamiyo has taken the throne of Kamigawa and is in the throne room with her husband free.
